profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer - Digital Experience at Adobe

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Digital Experience
positions.description:
Front end software development in javascript/react for Analytics Workspace
Front end software development in typescript/react native for Adobe Mobile Analytics App
Front end software development in typescript/react Report Builder v2

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Workbench
positions.description: Front end software development C++ for Data Workbench

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed software for cable set top boxes (in C, C++, Actionscript, Splat, and MAXX); and developed software for the Massive Data project (in C, PHP, SQL, and some distributed processing).  Projects included the RIOT engine, the Time Warner suite of interactive applications, the Emmy-nominated NBC Olympics Now application (lead developer), the Massive Data online processing system, and more.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
C++ Developer for the POS ONE Point of Sale System.  Coded a number of subsystems in a structured environment.  

Development Team Lead/Developer POS ONE Computer Based Training (Authorware).  
Managed and assigned defects, interfaced with management, and code development.

Developer MyTraining Computer Based Training (ASP/VBScript). 
Development, bug testing, maintenance, and helpdesk.

positions.title: Contractor
positions.description: Design and programming for a number of touch screen games for Coastal Amusements systems.  Games included: Gran’ma Jong, Field Goal, Foul Shot, Huntmaster, Jack Attack, Quickdraw Poker, Leapfrog, and others. Visual C++, Direct X, MFC, Watcom C++ for DOS, and Smaker.

positions.title: Producer and lead designer
positions.description:
Designed and produced the second and third episodes and the overarching storyline for the Windows 95 game Neophyte.  
Visual C++, Direct X, MFC, HTML, Perl.

company.name: Alien Software, a part of Microcosm Inc.

positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Programed on the WALL, the Windows Application Layer, which became the basic engine in The Blackstone Chronicles.  Visual C++, Direct X.  
Programed on the Pyotr’s Story, Framing Story, and Biochambre alternate interface sections of Callahan’s Crosstime Saloon.  Watcom C for DOS.  Also maintained an existing simulation for the Department of Justice.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead programmer on an adventure game based on the Highlander television show and movies.  A real-time 3D rendered game, using Renderware.  Visual C++, Renderware, and Direct X.  
Lead Programmer for the Icebreaker port from the 3DO to Windows 3.1 (compatible with windows 95).  Visual C++.
Developed the streaming code for the 3DO game, Icebreaker, also designed several levels for Icebreaker.  Developed a level-editing tool for in-house use. C++.
Lead Programmer for a multimedia title for Lionreef corporation for the 3DO.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Helpdesk and System Administrator duties for a user base of over 200.  Duties included helpdesk, installation, and designing and coding small programs to allow smooth function of helpdesk.
Maintained the SIGNET/Clover Tools.  The tools were used to manages the routers on a DOD network of over 300 routers and 1000 sub-networks.  Maintained, designed, and programmed proprietary software.  C/UNIX, HP Openview, NetMetrix, Sun Sparc.
Designed and coded the NAS_D command interpreter on a SCOPE 2000, Sco UNIX.
Produced telnet and e-mail utilities for the DEC PDP 11/70 for the UNIBUS NP100 ethernet TCP/IP board.  C/UNIX.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Modifying and maintaining Anisette system.  Powerhouse 4GL.  Maintain, develop and design software for the ITTB SCM.  C/UNIX.
Expanded Teams-3 Software Support.  C/UNIX, Ingres, Embedded SQL.
Created and maintained software for the Commis Bar Code Reader, IRL proprietary language.
